items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: Dave Carrick had spots in his face?

ctx.x: Well Crawford would remember his name too.

You know that right there, that double high ride cross, you know where to build a new house, you know where that boy died, Dave Carrick to live at? You know the car, Dave Carrick had spots in his face?
Yeah, I know, I'm trying to picture it.
